cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And returning it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
